description: GEMSDOE32 H33 scored 0.2778 (OWNER-REPORTED, not organizer-confirmed) by PRUNING dots at 1<d_cat<=2px from catalogue faults. This lane EMPHASIZES the intermediate collar zone (2-8 px = 200-800 m) where structural relay zones and dilational jogs form around mapped faults -- prime locations for geothermal-related blind faults absent from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue. Combined with Poisson-disc spacing (2.8 px) for emission uniqueness.

hypotheses.name: intermediate-collar relay-zone emphasis
hypotheses.mechanism: Unmapped geothermal-related faults cluster at 2-8 px (200-800 m) from catalogue faults where relay zones, dilational jogs, and secondary fractures form around mapped Quaternary faults. These blind faults are absent from the catalogue because USGS mapping focuses on through-going Quaternary traces.
hypotheses.cost: LOW -- uses only existing_faults.tif + sample_submission.tif (no external data, no training)
hypotheses.novelty: HIGH -- no lane in repo history has emphasized (vs pruned) the intermediate collar zone; H33 pruned 1<d_cat<=2px dots
hypotheses.holdout_reason: training_features.tif and labels.tif absent from checkout; no HOLDOUT-DTI computable
hypotheses.registry_note: 1 overlap firing vs GEMSDOE81 (0.8941 > 0.70); both target near-catalogue areas by construction
hypotheses.submission_reason: No HOLDOUT-DTI (no training data); literal full-support witness blocks all nonempty candidates; no organizer receipt

hypotheses.name: geothermal-surface-expression + structural-lineament intersection
hypotheses.mechanism: Geothermal surface expressions (sinter/travertine mounds, hydrothermal alteration, paleo-sinter hills) mark blind faults not in the catalogue. Intersecting DOE GDR #1391 paleo-geothermal deposits (726 sinter/tufa mounds) with structural lineaments from gravity-magnetic cross-gradient coherence targets faults missing from USGS/INGENIOUS.
hypotheses.cost: MEDIUM -- requires DOE GDR #1391 paleo-geothermal data (free, official, DOI-registered) + gravity/mag structural features (absent from checkout)
hypotheses.novelty: HIGH -- not yet implemented in any GEMSDOE lane; GDR 1391 is free official external data
hypotheses.obtainability: CHECKED -- GDR #1391 landing page accessible; data files require manual download (no automated scraping)

hypotheses.name: 3D MT conductance x heat-flow conduction corridor
hypotheses.mechanism: Geothermal systems require both high electrical conductance (MT) and high heat flow. Intersecting USGS MT conductivity models with heat-flow anomalies identifies deep conductive thermal anomalies that drive blind faulting. The GDR #1391 shallow probes and paleo-geothermal data provide ground truth.
hypotheses.cost: MEDIUM-HIGH -- requires MT models (USGS, free) + heat-flow data (SMU/NGDS, free)
hypotheses.novelty: MEDIUM -- MT+heat-flow intersection is described in repo hypotheses but not implemented
hypotheses.data_source: USGS MT models + SMU National Geothermal Data System (both free, official)
hypotheses.obtainability: UNVERIFIED -- need to confirm file availability and download mechanism

hypotheses.name: 1-m 3DEP LiDAR watershed-crossing scarp density
hypotheses.mechanism: Fault scarps crossing watershed boundaries create distinctive 1-m LiDAR topography. High scarp density at watershed crossings indicates active faulting not yet mapped. 3DEP 1-m LiDAR is free official USGS data.
hypotheses.cost: LOW-MEDIUM -- 3DEP 1-m LiDAR is free but large tiles require processing
hypotheses.novelty: MEDIUM -- LiDAR scarps used in H86I-RLMS but watershed-crossing density is new
hypotheses.obtainability: CHECKED -- 3DEP data is free and publicly available

hypotheses.name: hydrothermal-magnetite-destruction + vent-alignment corridor
hypotheses.mechanism: Hydrothermal alteration destroys magnetite, creating magnetic lows aligned with vent conduits. Combining RTP magnetic lows with thermal-spring alignments (GDR #1391) targets blind hydrothermal fault conduits.
hypotheses.cost: LOW-MEDIUM -- uses GDR #1391 thermal springs + existing magnetic data
hypotheses.novelty: MEDIUM -- similar to H86I-HVFD but with magnetite-destruction emphasis
hypotheses.data_source: DOE GDR #1391 thermal springs + USGS magnetic data

ranking_criteria: Expected DTI improvement (primary), implementation cost (secondary), data obtainability (tertiary). All hypotheses are unvalidated -- no HOLDOUT-DTI computable without training_features.tif and labels.tif.
